meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Bolivia merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) — institutional statistical identity
reports.description: National statistical office of the Plurinational State of Bolivia. Produces the core official statistics (household surveys, poverty, prices, national accounts inputs, census, external trade, etc.).
reports._notes: Institutional parent node for Bolivian official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.
_referenced_by: All major INE programme methodologies and technical reports
Banco Central de Bolivia publications that cite INE sources

reports.title: Encuesta de Hogares (EH) / Household Survey
reports.description: Annual household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with urban/rural and departmental domains.
reports._notes: Central social and labour survey. Official source for both labour statistics and monetary poverty. Conducted in the second half of each year; results feed the annual poverty and inequality publications.

reports.title: Pobreza monetaria / Monetary poverty
reports.description: Official income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence, calculated by comparing household per-capita income (from EH) with nationally defined poverty lines. Published with urban/rural and departmental breakdowns.
reports._notes: Headline social indicator. Recent estimates place total monetary poverty in the mid-to-high 30% range and extreme poverty in the low teens, with large urban–rural gaps. Series updated with revised population projections (EPP Rev. 2025).

reports.title: Líneas de pobreza y pobreza extrema
reports.description: Monetary values of the moderate and extreme poverty lines (per capita), differentiated for urban and rural areas and updated with price information.
reports._notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. Current methodology uses CBA 2015–2016 baskets; lines are published separately for urban and rural domains.

reports.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services.
reports._notes: Flagship price statistic. Produced by INE. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco Central de Bolivia and into the updating of poverty lines. Recent inflation has been elevated relative to the long-run low-inflation period.

reports.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Bolivia
reports.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Major base-year revision completed in 2025 (new reference year 2017, SCN 2008).
reports._notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. After ~30 years on a 1990 base, the 2017 reference year and SCN 2008 adoption represent a structural upgrade (validated with CEPAL/FMI support). Quarterly and annual releases.

reports.title: Banco Central de Bolivia — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
reports.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange-rate developments, and the monetary programme.
reports._notes: In the Bolivian division of labour INE leads prices, household surveys, poverty and national accounts; the BCB leads monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts monetary policy. Recent orientation has been contractive, aiming to bring inflation back to single digits and to rebuild reserves.

reports.title: Programa Monetario del BCB
reports.description: Annual monetary programme and periodic execution reports setting targets for monetary emission, net domestic credit and net international reserves.
reports._notes: Operational policy framework. Recent programmes emphasise a contractive stance, open-market operations for sterilisation, and a gradual path toward greater exchange-rate flexibility and an inflation-targeting regime.

reports.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys; underpins the revised population projections (EPP Rev. 2025).
reports._notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by EH design, poverty analysis and the 2025 population-projection revision used to reweight survey series.

reports.title: Índice de Gini / Income inequality
reports.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality calculated from EH income data. Companion indicator to the monetary-poverty series.
reports._notes: Structural inequality measure. Published nationally and by urban/rural area alongside the annual poverty results.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
reports.description: Quarterly and annual balance of payments covering the current account, capital/financial account and changes in reserve assets.
reports._notes: Core external-accounts product. Current-account outcomes have been under pressure as gas exports decline; recent periods show mixed results driven by mineral prices and remittances.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
reports.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods. Export basket dominated by minerals (gold, silver, zinc, tin), hydrocarbons (gas), and non-traditional agro-products (soy derivatives, beef, Brazil nuts).
reports._notes: Primary high-frequency trade product. 2025 exports ~USD 9.6 bn. Minerals have overtaken hydrocarbons as the leading export category after the structural decline in gas production and the end of the Argentina gas contract.

reports.title: Gas natural — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Statistics of natural-gas production and exports. Historically the dominant export and fiscal-revenue source; now in structural decline.
reports._notes: Structural turning point. Gas exports fell ~34% in value in 2025; the Argentina contract ended in 2024 and volumes to Brazil have declined. Once the backbone of the fiscal and external accounts; now a diminishing pillar.

reports.title: Minerales — oro, plata, zinc, estaño
reports.description: Statistics of mineral production and exports (gold, silver, zinc, tin and others). Now the leading merchandise-export category by value.
reports._notes: Current export engine. 2025 mineral exports ~USD 5.6 bn (+26%), driven by gold and silver prices. Replaces gas as the primary external-revenue source in the short term.

reports.title: Soya y derivados — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Statistics of soybean and soybean-product production and exports. Leading non-traditional agro-export, concentrated in the eastern lowlands (Santa Cruz).
reports._notes: Key non-traditional export. Complements the mineral and (declining) hydrocarbon pillars; production and export geography is heavily Santa Cruz–centred.

reports.title: Departamento de Santa Cruz — low-poverty economic hub
reports.description: Eastern lowland department and the country’s main agro-industrial and commercial engine. Lowest departmental poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Economic counterweight to the highland departments. Poverty incidence among the lowest in the country (~20–25% range in recent readings); hosts the bulk of soy, beef and related agro-industry.

reports.title: Departamento de Potosí — high-poverty highland contrast
reports.description: Highland mining department with among the highest poverty and extreme-poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Poverty-contrast department. Frequently ranks near the top of departmental poverty (mid-to-high 40s–50s % in recent years) despite its historic and ongoing mining role.

reports.title: Departamento de Chuquisaca — high-poverty contrast
reports.description: Southern highland/valley department with elevated poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Completes the high-poverty highland set alongside Potosí. Poverty incidence often above 50% in recent readings.

reports.title: Departamento de La Paz — capital region
reports.description: Western highland department containing the seat of government (La Paz) and El Alto. Intermediate-to-higher poverty and the largest absolute number of people in poverty.
reports._notes: Demographic and political core. Large absolute poverty mass even when rates are not the highest; hosts the dual-city complex of La Paz and El Alto.

reports.title: Pobreza monetaria por departamento (INE)
reports.description: Official departmental tabulations of monetary poverty. Primary source for the inter-departmental poverty gradient.
reports._notes: Key homogeneity-test product. Clear pattern: highland departments (Potosí, Chuquisaca, parts of La Paz) carry the highest rates; Santa Cruz the lowest. Absolute poverty is concentrated in the three largest departments (La Paz, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba).

reports.title: La Paz / El Alto — dual-city metropolitan complex
reports.description: Dual-city capital complex: La Paz (seat of government) and the adjacent, rapidly grown city of El Alto on the Altiplano. Primary urban domain for labour, income, poverty and social-programme analysis in the western highlands.
reports._notes: Lived-economy core of the western highlands. El Alto in particular is a dense, commercially dynamic, largely Aymara city that grew from migration; multidimensional poverty readings remain elevated. Continuously cited as a distinct geographic domain in household-survey and urban-poverty analysis.

reports.title: Yacimientos de Litio Bolivianos (YLB) — state lithium company
reports.publisher: YLB / Ministerio de Hidrocarburos y Energía
reports.description: State company charged with the industrialisation of Bolivia’s lithium resources, centred on the Salar de Uyuni (world’s largest known resources). Contracts with Chinese and Russian partners for direct-extraction plants.
reports._notes: Strategic future-resource node. Production remains far below commercial scale relative to Chile and Argentina; recent contracts (CBC/China, Uranium One/Russia) aim to scale direct lithium extraction. Continuously cited in industrial-policy and fiscal-revenue outlook analysis.

reports.title: Salar de Uyuni — lithium resource base
reports.description: World’s largest known lithium resource (salt flat in Potosí department). Geographic and symbolic core of Bolivia’s lithium strategy.
reports._notes: Foundational natural-resource node. Continuously cited as the physical base of the lithium industrialisation effort; also a national and Indigenous heritage symbol.

reports.title: Impuesto Directo a los Hidrocarburos (IDH)
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas Públicas / YPFB
reports.description: Direct tax on hydrocarbons. Historically the central fiscal instrument that channelled gas rents into national and subnational budgets and social programmes.
reports._notes: Structural fiscal node of the gas era. As gas production and exports decline, IDH revenues have fallen sharply, tightening the fiscal space that once financed large social transfers and public investment.

reports.title: Renta Dignidad — universal old-age pension
reports.description: Non-contributory universal pension for older adults. Flagship social-protection programme financed in part from hydrocarbon rents.
reports._notes: Lived-economy social node. Continuously cited in poverty-reduction and inequality analysis; one of the most visible redistributive instruments of the post-2006 period.

reports.title: Bono Juancito Pinto — school attendance cash transfer
reports.description: Conditional cash transfer paid to schoolchildren (and families) to encourage enrolment, attendance and completion. Covers primary and secondary levels.
reports._notes: Core education–social linkage. Continuously cited in education-access and poverty-reduction analysis; complements administrative enrolment statistics.

reports.title: Bono Juana Azurduy — maternal and early-childhood transfer
reports.description: Conditional cash transfer for pregnant women and children under two, aimed at improving maternal and child health outcomes.
reports._notes: Core health–social linkage. Continuously cited in maternal/child-health and poverty-reduction analysis.

reports.title: Sistema educativo — cobertura y gasto
reports.description: Education-system statistics (enrolment, attendance, institutional counts) and public education expenditure. Complements the Juancito Pinto transfer.
reports._notes: Education remains a major functional allocation and a visible social priority. Attendance and completion gaps persist, especially in rural and highland areas.

reports.title: Sistema de salud — cobertura y gasto
reports.description: Public health-system statistics and health expenditure. Complements the Juana Azurduy transfer and the broader social-protection architecture.
reports._notes: Health access and out-of-pocket spending remain structural concerns, especially outside the main urban centres. Continuously tracked in social and fiscal analysis.

reports.title: MERCOSUR accession & Andean Community (CAN) membership
reports.description: Bolivia’s dual regional-integration status: full member of the Andean Community and (more recently) member of MERCOSUR. Shapes preferential trade access and external-agenda positioning.
reports._notes: Core trade-architecture node. Bolivia’s MERCOSUR membership is recent; full participation in the MERCOSUR–EU preferential arrangement is still being clarified. CAN remains the older Andean preferential framework.
_referenced_by: Discussion of Bolivia’s participation in the MERCOSUR–EU agreement

reports.title: Presupuesto General del Estado / National Budget
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas Públicas
reports.description: Annual national budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues and expenditure of the public sector.
reports._notes: Operational fiscal framework. Links tax, hydrocarbon (IDH, royalties) and other revenues with functional spending on education, health, social protection and investment. Recent budgets reflect pressure from declining gas income and rising debt service.

reports.title: Recaudación tributaria y aduanera
reports.description: Tax and customs collection statistics. Primary non-hydrocarbon revenue-side fiscal product.
reports._notes: Core revenue statistic. Complements the declining IDH/royalty stream. Large stocks of uncollected tax debt have become a policy issue.

reports.title: Deuda pública / Public debt statistics
reports.description: Stock and flow statistics of public debt (external and domestic). Key sustainability indicator under fiscal pressure.
reports._notes: Critical fiscal-sustainability node. Domestic debt has grown sharply as external financing tightened and deficits persisted; recent fiscal deficits have been in the double-digit % of GDP range.

reports.title: Yacimientos Petrolíferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB)
reports.description: State hydrocarbons company. Producer, exporter and fiscal contributor (royalties, IDH) of natural gas and related products.
reports._notes: Institutional parent of the gas-era fiscal model. Production and export decline has cascading effects on IDH, royalties, YPFB finances and the broader public-sector accounts.

reports.title: Informalidad laboral / Labour informality
reports.description: Share of employed persons in informal employment. Structural feature of the Bolivian labour market and a primary determinant of household income security.
reports._notes: Lived-economy cornerstone. Informality rates are among the highest in South America (often cited near or above 80% of employment). Most households depend primarily or exclusively on informal income; formal employment is strongly protective against poverty.

reports.title: Departamento de Cochabamba — central valley hub
reports.description: Central valley department and the third major population and economic pole after La Paz and Santa Cruz. Intermediate poverty and large absolute poverty mass.
reports._notes: Completes the central economic axis (La Paz–Cochabamba–Santa Cruz). Large absolute number of people in poverty even when rates are not the highest.

reports.title: Departamento de Tarija — southern gas and agricultural zone
reports.description: Southern department historically linked to gas production and agricultural activity. Intermediate poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Gas-producing department. Poverty rates intermediate; economic structure has been shaped by the hydrocarbon cycle that is now contracting.

reports.title: Departamento de Oruro — highland mining
reports.description: Highland mining department with intermediate-to-elevated poverty.
reports._notes: Mining geography. Completes the highland departmental set alongside Potosí, Chuquisaca and La Paz.

reports.title: Departamento del Beni — northern lowland
reports.description: Northern Amazonian lowland department. Intermediate poverty with marked urban–rural gaps.
reports._notes: Lowland contrast to the highland departments. Completes the geographic coverage of the main departmental poverty gradient.

reports.title: Empresas públicas — performance and fiscal exposure
reports.description: State-owned enterprise sector (YPFB, YLB, BoA, Mi Teleférico, Mutún, etc.). Material source of fiscal risk when losses and debt accumulate.
reports._notes: Lived fiscal-risk node. A large group of state firms have operated at a loss; a subset has been flagged as critically indebted. Restructuring and possible liquidation have entered the policy agenda as gas rents decline.

reports.title: Remesas familiares / Family remittances
reports.description: Inflows of personal transfers from Bolivians living abroad. Major secondary-income item in the balance of payments and a direct support to household consumption.
reports._notes: Lived-economy external support. Annual inflows on the order of USD 1.2–1.3 bn. Spain is the dominant origin (~50%); destination is heavily concentrated in Santa Cruz, Cochabamba and La Paz. Continuously cited as a stabilising source of foreign exchange and household income when other external flows are under pressure.

reports.title: Necesidades Básicas Insatisfechas (NBI) / Unsatisfied Basic Needs
reports.description: Structural (non-monetary) poverty measure based on deprivations in housing, services, education and health. Complementary to the income-poverty series.
reports._notes: Long-run living-conditions indicator. Census-based; shows large historical improvement but a persistent rural–urban gap (rural NBI still several times urban). Housing space and services remain the most frequent deprivations.

reports.title: Inseguridad alimentaria / Food insecurity (ELCSA scale)
reports.description: Experience-based food-insecurity indicators from the household survey using the Latin American and Caribbean Food Security Scale.
reports._notes: Lived hunger and worry indicator. Recent readings show elevated concern about running out of food and a non-trivial share of households reporting hunger; trends have worsened in the early-2020s stress period.

reports.title: Inversión Extranjera Directa / FDI statistics
reports.description: Statistics of foreign direct investment flows and stocks by sector. Part of the external accounts and specialised BCB analysis.
reports._notes: FDI has been modest and concentrated; hydrocarbons and manufacturing have been recurrent destinations. Net flows are small relative to the investment needs implied by the lithium and industrialisation agenda.

reports.title: Industria manufacturera — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Manufacturing production and export statistics. Includes soy derivatives, processed foods, textiles, wood products and other non-traditional manufactures.
reports._notes: Industrial-commercial layer beyond primary extraction. Soy crushing and related agro-industry dominate the export side; the broader manufacturing base remains relatively shallow.

reports.title: Empleo formal / Formal employment
reports.description: Share and absolute number of employed persons in formal jobs (with social-security coverage or registered contracts). Complement to the informality series.
reports._notes: Protective labour status. Formal workers have substantially lower poverty incidence. The formal share remains a minority of total employment.

reports.title: Condiciones de vivienda y servicios básicos
reports.description: Housing quality, overcrowding, and access to water, sanitation and electricity. Core components of the NBI measure and of everyday living standards.
reports._notes: Direct lived-conditions node. Inadequate housing space is among the most frequent NBI deprivations; rural service gaps remain large.

reports.title: Mortalidad infantil y neonatal
reports.description: Infant and neonatal mortality rates. Long-run health-outcome indicator complementary to the maternal-transfer and health-system nodes.
reports._notes: Long-run improvement is clear (large declines over recent decades), yet levels remain higher than Southern Cone peers. Links to the Juana Azurduy transfer and public-health capacity.

reports.title: Departamento de Pando — northern Amazonian extreme
reports.description: Northernmost Amazonian department. Low population density, intermediate poverty, and distinct lowland living conditions.
reports._notes: Completes the full departmental set. Geographic and demographic extreme relative to the highland and central-axis departments.

reports.title: Eje central (La Paz – Cochabamba – Santa Cruz)
reports.description: The three-department demographic and economic corridor that concentrates the majority of population, formal activity, remittance inflows and absolute poverty numbers.
reports._notes: Analytical geography node. Most remittances, formal jobs and absolute poverty counts sit on this axis; the rest of the country is thinner demographically and economically.

reports.title: Autoidentificación indígena originaria campesina (Censo)
reports.description: Census and survey statistics of population self-identification with Indigenous nations, peoples, or Afro-Bolivian identity. Core plurinational demographic indicator.
reports._notes: Foundational identity node of the Plurinational State. Censo 2024: 38.7% self-identify as Indigenous or Afro-Bolivian (Quechua and Aymara the largest nations). Share has declined from 62% (2001) and 41% (2012) even as absolute numbers remain large. Continuously cited in territorial, language and rights analysis.

reports.title: Naciones Quechua y Aymara — demographic weight
reports.description: The two largest Indigenous nations by self-identification. Together they account for the large majority of the Indigenous population.
reports._notes: Lived identity core of the highlands. Quechua ~1.65 m, Aymara ~1.60 m in Censo 2024. Geography overlaps heavily with the western departments and with the La Paz / El Alto metropolitan complex.

reports.title: Territorios Indígena Originario Campesinos (TIOC)
reports.description: Indigenous Originary Peasant Territories — recognised collective territorial units that appear as geographic domains in census and survey tabulations.
reports._notes: Plurinational territorial node. Continuously cited as a distinct geographic and rights unit in official statistics and policy.
_referenced_by: Poverty and service-access studies that disaggregate by TIOC

reports.title: Contrato litio YLB–CBC (China)
reports.description: Investment and service contract for direct lithium extraction and residual-brine plants in the Salar de Uyuni area, with Chinese consortium participation and majority state stake.
reports._notes: Major international industrial-investment instrument. Part of the attempt to scale lithium production from the current low base; subject to ongoing political and legislative scrutiny.
_referenced_by: Policy debate on contract transparency and local benefit

reports.title: Contrato litio YLB–Uranium One (Rusia)
reports.description: Investment contract for a direct lithium extraction plant with Russian partner, complementary to the Chinese CBC arrangement.
reports._notes: Second major international lithium-investment instrument. Together with the CBC contract, defines the current external partnership architecture for lithium industrialisation.

reports.title: Relación energética Bolivia–Brasil (gasoducto y gas)
reports.description: Long-standing natural-gas export relationship with Brazil via the Bolivia–Brazil gas pipeline. Still the principal residual gas-export market after the end of the Argentina contract.
reports._notes: Core bilateral energy relationship. Volumes have declined but Brazil remains the main residual buyer; recent high-level statements explore ways to stabilise or expand cooperation.
_referenced_by: Analysis of the structural decline in gas volumes

reports.title: Tasa de alfabetismo / Literacy rate
reports.description: Literacy rate for the adult population, published nationally and by Indigenous self-identification, area and department.
reports._notes: Long-run education-outcome indicator. National adult literacy has improved substantially (illiteracy now in the mid-single digits); gaps remain by area and by Indigenous identification.

reports.title: Idiomas hablados / Language statistics
reports.description: Statistics of languages spoken (Spanish, Quechua, Aymara and others), from census and household surveys. Core plurinational cultural indicator.
reports._notes: Lived cultural node. Complements self-identification; Spanish is dominant in urban areas while Indigenous languages retain substantial weight, especially in highland and rural domains.

reports.title: Población de 65 años y más / Population ageing
reports.description: Share and absolute size of the population aged 65 and over. Demographic context for the Renta Dignidad and health-system pressure.
reports._notes: Ageing signal. Share has risen (Censo 2024: ~7.4%). Links directly to the fiscal and social sustainability of the universal old-age pension.

reports.title: Relación comercial con China
reports.description: Bilateral trade relationship with China — major destination for minerals and origin of imports, and partner in lithium industrialisation.
reports._notes: Structural commercial and investment partner. Continuously cited in export (minerals) and import (machinery, intermediates) analysis and in the lithium partnership architecture.

dependencies.basis: Monetary poverty is calculated from EH household income data.
Poverty status is determined by comparing per-capita income with the official poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with price information derived from the IPC.
The Gini coefficient is computed from the same income distribution underlying the poverty estimates.
Merchandise trade flows are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
Santa Cruz is the principal production and export base for soy and related agro-industry.
Potosí’s high poverty ranking is derived from the departmental poverty tabulations.
YLB’s industrialisation effort is centred on the Salar de Uyuni resource base.
IDH revenues are directly tied to hydrocarbon production and prices.
Hydrocarbon rents (including IDH) have been a primary financing source for the universal pension.
Preferential access under CAN and MERCOSUR structures a large share of regional trade.
IDH and hydrocarbon royalties remain material revenue lines in the national budget.
IDH and royalty flows originate from YPFB hydrocarbon operations.
Informality rates are derived from the household-survey employment modules.
Cochabamba’s poverty ranking and absolute poverty mass are derived from the departmental tables.
The large majority of remittance inflows are received in Santa Cruz, Cochabamba and La Paz.
Housing and basic-services deprivations are core components of the NBI measure.
Food-insecurity indicators are derived from the household survey.
Infant-mortality outcomes are a key performance indicator of the health system.
Indigenous self-identification is a core census question and tabulation domain.
The Brazil gas relationship structures the residual export market for Bolivian natural gas.
Literacy rates are a core long-run outcome indicator of the education system.
China is a major export destination and import origin in the merchandise-trade statistics.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
